backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing access control, logo and AdMob config storage, user/session maps, metrics tracking, and admin/user APIs.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a no-op migration that forwards old actor state to the new schema.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for all frontend source files used as reference metadata.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global CSS defining light and dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point loading the main frontend app.
frontend/public/admin/index.html: Admin panel HTML entry point with its own title for deep-linking.
frontend/README.md: Frontend documentation describing features, setup, and development workflow.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling auth, routing, install tracking, header logo rendering, and page selection.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Handles authentication flow, loading states, and initial profile setup before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Provides login/logout button logic using Internet Identity with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/RewardedAdStubMo: Simulates a rewarded video ad with timed progress and triggers completion or cancellation events.
Displays VPN session status, unlock flow via rewarded ad, blocked-state handling, and disconnect actions.
frontend/src/config/admob.ts: Contains placeholder AdMob app IDs, rewarded ad unit IDs, and ad-related configuration settings.
frontend/src/config/support.ts: Exports centralized support email and application name constants.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity and refetches dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminPanel.ts: Provides hooks to check admin status and fetch the admin user overview.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppAdMobConfig.ts: Defines hooks for fetching and updating AdMob configuration, with admin and public access variants.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppLogo.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and upload the application logo via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppMetrics.ts: Allows admins to fetch app metrics and supports incrementing install counts.
Defines a mutation to clear VPN sessions and refresh session status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity auth state, including loading, login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile using React Query and the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionStatus.ts: Polls and computes session status, remaining time, and activity state based on backend session info.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnlockSession.ts: Creates a mutation to unlock user sessions and handles errors and refetching session status.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserBlocking.ts: Provides hooks to check, block, and unblock users along with current-user block status using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base configuration with custom color variables and theme settings for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Implements the admin dashboard for managing users, sessions, AdMob config, logos, metrics, and admin status.
frontend/src/pages/ContactUsPage.tsx: Renders a support contact page with email links and guidance for reaching customer support.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Renders a styled Privacy Policy page showing sections on data collection, usage, and contact with dynamic last‑updated date.
frontend/src/pages/TermsOfServicePage.ts: Displays the Terms of Service with sections on acceptance, service description, user accounts, and acceptable use.
frontend/src/utils/timeFormat.ts: Provides a utility to convert seconds into HH:MM:SS formatted strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, storing them in sessionStorage, retrieving persisted values, and cleaning parameters from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, container settings, and enabling typography, container queries, and animations plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current goals, existing features, and state for finalizing the VPN Super Pro app.
